name: Symmetric downlight

original_specification.name: Symmetric downlight
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for ceiling-luminaire visualization.
original_specification.geometry: Real mounting height and receiving plane
original_specification.contribution_policy: Use documented profile distribution and flux; no artistic normalization by default
original_specification.authoring_method: Original authoring specification requiring a separately sourced and licensed IES/LDT profile or a clearly labeled analytic distribution. No profile asset or absolute measurement is included.
validation: Preserve orientation, profile integral and provenance

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Original luminaire-shaped area source, not measured IES/LDT intensity distribution or lux validation.
Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
